description: Consider a prime number prime(i) with k digits (d_1, d_2, ..., d_k), where d_k is the units digit. Consider the k preceding prime numbers prime(i-1), prime(i-2), ..., prime(i-k) and the numbers obtained by concatenating [d_1, prime(i-1)], [d_2, prime(i-2)], ..., [d_k, prime(i-k)]. If the latter are all prime, then prime(i) belongs to the sequence.
